semantics: Shared implementation validates the same bounded READY and TREE_CLOSED schema. Evaluation public signatures, exception strings and representative old-module outcomes are preserved by a full-snapshot comparison test.
Training identity requires an actual matching AttemptRef for task/attempt/phase. Historical native rows without protocol cannot obtain ownership merely from a raw process or return code.

Normal publication requires an exact persisted supervision binding. LAUNCHING initialization cleanup may acquire its first bound READY only with explicit confirmed STOP closure; historical missing-protocol rows remain rejected.

Worker returncode remains the real code. stop_requested or forced_cleanup blocks completed outcome; training fallback reason is training_process_tree_stopped. Explicit interrupted outcomes remain interrupted.
The shared adapter is a metadata/protocol checker, not an attempt-authority transaction, OS discovery, recovery mechanism or supervisor implementation.
